name: unigram evaluation perplexity
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=1, alpha=1.0).train("aab")
assert math.isclose(model.evaluate("ab"), 2.041241452319315, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isinf(model.evaluate(""))
assert math.isinf(model.evaluate("az"))

name: bigram training resets previous state
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=2, alpha=1.0)
assert model.train("ababa") is model
assert math.isclose(model.evaluate("ab"), math.sqrt(2.0), rel_tol=1e-9)
model.train("bb")
assert math.isclose(model.evaluate("bb"), 1.0, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isinf(model.evaluate("ab"))

name: seeded generation is reproducible
test:
model = NGramCharModel(n=2, alpha=0.1).train("ababababac")
first = model.generate("a", max_new_chars=30, seed=7)
second = model.generate("a", max_new_chars=30, seed=7)
assert first == second
assert first.startswith("a")
assert len(first) == 31
assert set(first[1:]) <= set("abc")
assert model.generate("seed", max_new_chars=0, seed=1) == "seed"

name: invalid arguments and untrained behavior
input: n = 0, alpha = 0, empty train text, untrained generation
test:
import math

def expect_value_error(callable_obj):
    try:
        callable_obj()
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")

expect_value_error(lambda: NGramCharModel(n=0))
expect_value_error(lambda: NGramCharModel(alpha=0))
model = NGramCharModel()
expect_value_error(lambda: model.train(""))
expect_value_error(lambda: model.generate("", max_new_chars=1))
assert math.isinf(model.evaluate("abc"))
model.train("abc")
expect_value_error(lambda: model.generate("", max_new_chars=-1))

name: tiny Shakespeare train generate evaluate workflow
test:
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path

data_root = os.environ.get("DEEPCODE_DATA_PATH")
assert data_root, "DEEPCODE_DATA_PATH must point to a directory containing tiny_shakespeare.txt"
text = (Path(data_root) / "tiny_shakespeare.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8").replace("\r\n", "\n")
assert len(text) >= 200, "tiny_shakespeare.txt is unexpectedly small"
split = int(len(text) * 0.8)
train_text = text[:split]
heldout = text[split:]
training_vocab = set(train_text)
heldout_known = "".join(ch for ch in heldout if ch in training_vocab)[:500]
assert len(heldout_known) >= 50, "heldout split has too little known-vocabulary text"
model = NGramCharModel(n=4, alpha=0.5).train(train_text)
prompt = heldout_known[:20]
generated = model.generate(prompt, max_new_chars=80, seed=13)
assert generated.startswith(prompt)
assert len(generated) == len(prompt) + 80
assert set(generated[len(prompt):]) <= training_vocab
score = model.evaluate(heldout_known)
assert math.isfinite(score)
assert 1.0 <= score <= max(100.0, len(training_vocab) * 2.5)
